output.text: Welcome to your new Pebble Press! To get started, place one blank card in the tray. Then, choose a pattern from the selection on the screen. The sample print you see uses the pattern you’ve chosen, so you’ll know exactly how it will look. Once you’re ready, tap ‘Start’ to begin your first impression. The Pebble Press is designed to make creating beautiful, decorative cards easy and fun. Enjoy crafting your unique designs with every press!
